purpose: Scoped fresh ordinary-input campaign progression through 13 unique native jobs and paid Island timeout handling. All 96 jobs, two measured enjoyable hours and hardware remain unverified.

inspection.method: Ordinary held-button sets and genuine in-game four-button resets; read-only WRAM inspection, no memory writes, injected progression, checkpoint restoration, browser or device action.
inspection.labelMeaning: Labels describe inspection intent; decoded state and mode determine what actually completed. Completion rows use the first observed done increment, including vehicle recovery after the result for job 4.

scope: All twelve prerequisite completions plus Centre Letters earned in one fresh save, thirteen distinct jobs spanning the eight native job kinds.
Vehicle impacts/pedestrian fines/pursuit and police capture occurred naturally; fragile/foot work, truck supplies, passenger driving, train and bus relay and scheduled ferry objectives completed.
Centre Letters unlocked after 12 unique jobs; 195-second deadline, condition 100 with 136 seconds left, regular ferry fares 4+4 and reward 118+27=145.
Active Island MAP froze all 58 state bytes for 360 frames; client carrying and paid-return resets preserved job, timer, cash and original mainland parked car.
Unpaid ferry WAIT cancellation preserved active job/cash; returning requires actual ordered Select handoffs, no arrival auto-completion.
Repeated Select on RESULT and genuine reset preserved 13 unique completions and cash 1802 without a second reward.

An intentionally incomplete Centre Letters replay expired during a paid return RIDE: condition 0, no active job, and no time left. The remaining 2 seconds of riding resumed through genuine reset and arrived with a failed +$0 RESULT, cash 1794, done 13 and the bitmap unchanged.
